sections.title: 19th Century American Art Seminar: Early Black Makers
sections.description: This seminar examines the history of art, artists, and artistic movements that emerged in the United States during the long nineteenth century. It may also engage with histories of visual culture, criticism, and the theory of art. Specific topics vary from semester to semester.
